div.head: Hn 4
div.ab: De generibus causarum. (De causarum liberatione.) Genera causarum tria sunt: deliberatiuum de faciendo et non faciendo, demonstratiuum de laude uel uituperio, iudiciale de pena uel merito.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 547 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

div.ab: On the kinds of cases. (On the deliberation [?] of cases.) The kinds of cases are three: deliberative, about doing and not doing; demonstrative, about praise or blame; judicial, about punishment or reward.
